# launchd-logging

## launchd.logging.enable

Whether to enable funnelling every `launchd.daemons` and `launchd.user.agents` job’s
stdout and stderr into `<directory>/<Label>.log`, rotated by
`system.newsyslog`.

launchd discards a job’s output unless it names a file. With this
enabled, each job’s `StandardOutPath` and `StandardErrorPath`
default (`mkDefault`) to its log file; jobs that set their own at
normal priority keep them, outside this directory and its rotation.
That includes several of nix-darwin’s modules, e.g.
`services.netdata` and `services.wg-quick`. inetd-style jobs are
never redirected.

A module that wants a log path of its own, while letting this
claim the job, should set it with `lib.mkOverride 1100`: below
`mkDefault`, but above the option’s `null` default.

*Type:*
boolean

*Default:*

```nix
false
```

*Example:*

```nix
true
```

*Declared by:*

- [\<nixham/modules/nix-darwin/launchd/logging/default.nix>](../../../modules/nix-darwin/launchd/logging/default.nix)

## launchd.logging.directory

Directory each job’s `<Label>.log` is written to. Created
root-owned, mode 0755. A daemon’s log file is owned by its
`serviceConfig.UserName` and `GroupName` (default `root:wheel`), a
user agent’s by `launchd.user.agents.<name>.logging.owner`
and `launchd.user.agents.<name>.logging.group`.

*Type:*
string

*Default:*

```nix
"/var/log/launchd"
```

*Declared by:*

- [\<nixham/modules/nix-darwin/launchd/logging/default.nix>](../../../modules/nix-darwin/launchd/logging/default.nix)

## launchd.logging.excludeDaemons

`launchd.daemons` to leave alone: those whose fd 1 or 2 must not be
redirected, e.g. a socket-activated job handed its client socket
without being inetd-compatible. Daemons that set
`serviceConfig.inetdCompatibility` are left alone anyway.

*Type:*
list of string

*Default:*

```nix
[ ]
```

*Example:*

```nix
[
  "my-socket-activated-job"
]
```

*Declared by:*

- [\<nixham/modules/nix-darwin/launchd/logging/default.nix>](../../../modules/nix-darwin/launchd/logging/default.nix)

## launchd.logging.rotation.count

Number of rotated archives newsyslog keeps per log file.

*Type:*
unsigned integer, meaning >=0

*Default:*

```nix
5
```

*Declared by:*

- [\<nixham/modules/nix-darwin/launchd/logging/default.nix>](../../../modules/nix-darwin/launchd/logging/default.nix)

## launchd.logging.rotation.flags

newsyslog flags for each log file: by default, compress with
bzip2 (`J`) and don’t signal syslogd (`N`), which isn’t the writer.

launchd jobs can’t reopen their stdio, so a long-running job
writes to the rotated file until it is next spawned.

*Type:*
list of string

*Default:*

```nix
[
  "J"
  "N"
]
```

*Declared by:*

- [\<nixham/modules/nix-darwin/launchd/logging/default.nix>](../../../modules/nix-darwin/launchd/logging/default.nix)

## launchd.logging.rotation.size

Size in KB at which newsyslog rotates a log file, or `null` not to rotate by size.

*Type:*
null or string

*Default:*

```nix
"1024"
```

*Declared by:*

- [\<nixham/modules/nix-darwin/launchd/logging/default.nix>](../../../modules/nix-darwin/launchd/logging/default.nix)

## launchd.logging.rotation.when

newsyslog’s schedule for rotating a log file, or `null` not to rotate by time.

*Type:*

*Default:*


*Example:*

## launchd.user.agents.\<name>.logging.group

Group of this agent’s log file under `launchd.logging.directory`.

*Type:*
string

*Default:*

```nix
if elem config.system.primaryUser config.users.knownUsers
then toString config.users.users.${config.system.primaryUser}.gid
else "staff"

```

*Declared by:*

- [\<nixham/modules/nix-darwin/launchd/logging/default.nix>](../../../modules/nix-darwin/launchd/logging/default.nix)

## launchd.user.agents.\<name>.logging.owner

Owner of this agent’s log file under `launchd.logging.directory`.

launchd opens it as the session’s user, and fails the spawn
(`EX_CONFIG`) if that user can’t. Activation creates it with this
owner, and newsyslog recreates it with the same owner after
rotation.

*Type:*
string

*Default:*

```nix
config.system.primaryUser
```

*Declared by:*

- [\<nixham/modules/nix-darwin/launchd/logging/default.nix>](../../../modules/nix-darwin/launchd/logging/default.nix)
